data.body: Live reproduction (2026-06-03, session worktree-20260603-084946): an Agent dispatch with isolation:worktree (agent a05f76b7d92b525e6, worktree /Users/joeoakhart/digital-service-orchestra/.claude/worktrees/agent-a05f76b7d92b525e6) ALSO executed git operations against the parent session worktree — created branch audit/c2-leaf-gap there and switched the session checkout to it mid-session (observed via harness file-change notifications showing pre-chunk-5-era file contents; session was on autofix-chunk11-20260603). Working tree was clean so recovery was a branch switch + stray-branch delete; no work lost. The agent's intended work landed correctly in ITS worktree on audit/c2-leaf-gap-agent (pushed). Evidence strengthens the un-isolated-dispatch failure mode this ticket tracks.
